versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the scrape-applied-links skill.
- Provides a CLI to batch-run render-and-parse on every url in a JSON list or label-keyed object.
- Records paths to rendered and parsed output files back into each object for later use and deduplication.
- Supports --dry-run, --force, and --output-dir options to control scraping behavior and output location.
- Saves progress incrementally after processing each url to prevent data loss on interruption or error.
- Skips already-processed urls unless --force is specified; prints clear logs and failure summaries.
